title: Datadog IaC Resource Inventory
description: A purpose-built inventory of the Infrastructure-as-Code resources discovered by the Datadog IaC Scanner. Unlike the SARIF findings report, this document enumerates every resource present in the scanned files, independent of whether any rule matched it.

schema_version.description: Version of this inventory document format.

tool.description: The tool that produced the inventory.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the inventory was generated.

root_path.description: The scanned root path or repository location.

resource_count.description: Number of resources in the inventory.

address.description: Stable, platform-native identifier for the resource. Examples: Terraform "aws_s3_bucket.b", "data.aws_ami.example", "module.network"; Kubernetes "default/Deployment/my-app" ("<namespace>/<kind>/<name>", namespace omitted for cluster-scoped objects); CloudFormation logical ID "MyBucket"; Ansible task name; Dockerfile stage alias or base image; CI/CD job identifier.

iac_platform.description: The IaC technology the resource was parsed from.

block_type.description: The category of block the resource originates from. "resource"/"data"/"module" are Terraform blocks ("resource" is also a CloudFormation logical resource); "manifest" is a Kubernetes object; "task" is an Ansible task; "stage" is a Dockerfile build stage; "job" is a CI/CD job or Dependabot update.

resource_type.description: The resource's type in its platform: Terraform type (e.g. "aws_s3_bucket"), Kubernetes kind (e.g. "Deployment"), CloudFormation type (e.g. "AWS::S3::Bucket"), Ansible module (e.g. "ansible.builtin.copy"), Dockerfile base image (e.g. "alpine:3.19"), or Dependabot package ecosystem. null when the block has no meaningful type (Terraform modules, CI/CD jobs).

name.description: The resource's local identifier: Terraform label, Kubernetes metadata.name, CloudFormation logical ID, Ansible task name, Dockerfile stage alias/image, or CI/CD job id.

provider.description: Provider inferred from the resource type prefix, e.g. "aws" (from "aws_s3_bucket" or "AWS::S3::Bucket"). Absent when it cannot be inferred.

file_path.description: Path of the file the resource was declared in.

module_source.description: The `source` argument of a module block. Present only when block_type is "module".

module_version.description: The `version` constraint of a module block, e.g. "~> 5.0". Present only when block_type is "module" and a version is specified.

module.description: Terraform module provenance aligned with SARIF properties.module. Present on module blocks and on resources/data declared inside instantiated modules. Direct module relationships omit module_path; transitive relationships include the ordered call chain.

api_version.description: The Kubernetes manifest apiVersion, e.g. "apps/v1". Present only when block_type is "manifest".

namespace.description: The Kubernetes metadata.namespace. Present only when block_type is "manifest" and a namespace is declared.

attributes.description: Every attribute declared in the resource block, extracted verbatim from the parsed source. Nested blocks are preserved as objects; repeated blocks as arrays. No filtering or curation is applied — unresolved references appear as their raw string representation. Annotation keys prefixed with _dd_ are stripped.

line_range.description: The line span of the resource. Values are 1-based when line information is available; 0 means the parser did not record a location (e.g. an empty or unannotated block). "end" is derived from the furthest annotated attribute inside the block and equals "start" when no wider range is known.

source_type.description: Module source classification: local, registry, git, or unknown.

version.description: Resolved registry semver or git commit SHA when known.

code_location.description: Module-relative location of the resource block when this object describes a resource inside a module.

module_path.description: Ordered module call chain from the customer declaration to the leaf module. Omitted for direct relationships.
